toegepas.voor: Net soos jy het elke kind by die eerste boere
toegepas.na: Net soos jy, het elke kind van die eerste boere
toegepas.rede_vinder: Without the comma 'Net soos jy het' first reads as 'just as you have', and the double 'by ... by' is clumsy.
toegepas.fout: 'Net soos jy het' first reads as 'just as you have', and 'by ... by' doubles the preposition clumsily.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma removes the garden path and 'kind van die eerste boere' names the same children, so the meaning holds.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'saamwoon' is a separable compound verb, so its past participle is written as one word.
toegepas.fout: 'saam gewoon' splits the separable verb 'saamwoon', unlike 'saamgewerk' in the next sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Standard spelling of the participle, matching the neighbouring 'saamgewerk', with the meaning unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans says someone stands 'bo' others in rank; 'oor ... gestaan' is not idiomatic.
toegepas.fout: 'oor verskeie hoofmanne gestaan' is not an idiomatic way to express rank.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'bo ... gestaan' is the natural expression for ranking above someone; the same relationship, and the protected 'hoofmanne' is untouched.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The relative refers to the land itself, so 'waarop' is more precise than 'waar'.
toegepas.fout: 'waar' after 'grond' is loose; the relative refers to the land itself.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'waarop' is the precise relative for building and planting on land and says the same thing.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'kos verbou' is the natural Afrikaans collocation; 'kos kweek' is wooden.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'jou eie kos kweek' is natural Afrikaans, and 'verbou' can also mean 'rebuild', which may confuse a Grade 5 reader.

laat_vaar.voor: wat ongelukkig was met hulle leier
laat_vaar.na: wat met hulle leier ongelukkig was
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In a written relative clause the finite verb goes to the end.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing the prepositional phrase after the verb is normal Afrikaans, so this is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Standard written Afrikaans uses 'ophou om te' with an infinitive here.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'opgehou bestaan' is accepted standard Afrikaans; the proposal only adds words.

na_skrywer.na: opperhoofskap, wat besluite vir sy mense neem
